parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols pim ipv6.explanation: 启用PIM（Protocol Independent Multicast）协议的IPv6支持。

set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 interfa.command: set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-1/0/0
set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 interfa.explanation: 配置OSPFv3协议在指定区域内的接口。

set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 interfa.command: set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-2/0/0
set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 interfa.explanation: 配置OSPFv3协议在指定区域内的接口。

set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 interfa.command: set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-3/0/0
set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 interfa.explanation: 配置OSPFv3协议在指定区域内的接口。

set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 interfa.command: set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-1/0/1
set protocols ospf3 area 0.0.0.0 interfa.explanation: 配置OSPFv3协议在指定区域内的接口。

set protocols pim ssm-groups ff3e::/64.explanation: 配置PIM协议的SSM（Source-Specific Multicast）组地址范围。

set protocols pim ssm-filter import 2000.explanation: 配置PIM协议的SSM过滤器，指定导入的过滤器编号。

set firewall family inet6 filter 2000 te.template: set firewall family inet6 filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] from destination-address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set firewall family inet6 filter 2000 te.command: set firewall family inet6 filter 2000 term 1 from destination-address FF3E::1/64
set firewall family inet6 filter 2000 te.explanation: 配置IPv6防火墙过滤器的条件，指定目的地址。

set firewall family inet6 filter 2000 te.template: set firewall family inet6 filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then [parameter3]
set firewall family inet6 filter 2000 te.command: set firewall family inet6 filter 2000 term 1 then accept
set firewall family inet6 filter 2000 te.explanation: 配置IPv6防火墙过滤器的动作，接受匹配的流量。

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: 对匹配流量的处理动作，例如accept。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet6 address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet6 address 2001:db8:5::1/64
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv6地址及前缀长度。

parameters.name: unit
